name: Elsasser packets
blurb: Two Alfven-wave packets heading for each other along a guide field, one of each Elsasser sign (z+ and z-): they interact only while they overlap, then separate, carrying the finer structure the collision gave them (Verniero et al. 2018). They meet at the center at t = 0.25 and again at the box's edge at t = 0.75. The setup follows the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
